app_store.name: Creative Activities
app_store.subtitle: Ubuciko nemidlalo yezithombe
app_store.promotional_text: Yenzani into ndawonye: imisebenzi elula yobuciko, amathayela amakhulu ezithombe nezithombe zomndeni wakho. Akukho thayima, akukho maphuzu, akukho akhawunti.
app_store.description:
Thola umsebenzi olula ongajabulela nokuwenza ndawonye. Creative Activities inikeza umdlalo omnene wokufanisa izithombe nokubuka izithombe ndawonye emindenini nakubanakekeli, kuhlanganise nalabo abachitha isikhathi nomuntu ophila nokukhohlwa (dementia) noma isifo i-Alzheimer.

QALA KANCANE
Qala ngamathayela amakhulu amane nemidwebo yokuqala eyaziwayo. Gcina izithombe ziboniswa, noma uzifihle uma kukhululekile. Imodi ethambile ayinakho ukuthayima, amaphuzu noma isijeziso. Khetha amathayela angu-4, 6, 8 noma 12 njengoba atholakala.

KUWENZE KUBE YIWAKHO
Khetha izithombe zomndeni usebenzisa isikhethi sezithombe sedivayisi yakho. Creative Activities igcina amakhophi amancane emisebenzini yasendaweni; ayiskeni umtapo wakho wezithombe futhi ayiguquli izithombe zakho zangempela. Ungagcina izithombe ezifika kweziyi-24 esiqoqweni esisodwa.

BHEKANI NDAWONYE KUPHELA
Buka isithombe esisodwa ngesikhathi. Imibuzo yokukhuluma engakhethwa isimemela ingxoxo ngaphandle kokucela muntu ukuthi akhumbule amagama noma aphendule ngokuyikho. Ukubuka nje kwanele.

NGAPHANDLE KWENETHIWEKHI LAPHO KUBALULEKILE
Imidwebo yokuqala iyatholakala ngokushesha. Amakhophi ezithombe ezingeniswe asebenza ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi ngemva kokungenisa. Ukukhetha izithombe zangempela ezigcinwe ku-iCloud kuphela kungadinga i-inthanethi. Wonke amaphakethe ayisishiyagalombili ezithombe afakiwe nohlelo lokusebenza, akukho okunye ukulanda izithombe.

AKUKHO AKHAWUNTI NOMLINGANISI WEZITHOMBE
Amakhophi ezithombe zomndeni ahlala ohlelweni lokusebenza kule divayisi. Ungasusa amakhophi ngaphandle kokusula izithombe zangempela. Okokulondoloza kwedivayisi kungafaka idatha yohlelo lokusebenza. Lolu hlobo alulinganiseli izithombe phakathi kwezihlobo.

Creative Activities iyokuzijabulisa nokuxoxa ndawonye. Ayihloli, ayelaphi, ayivimbeli, futhi ayilinganisi dementia noma isifo i-Alzheimer. Imisebenzi ayifanele wonke umuntu; landela izintshisekelo nenduduzo yalowo muntu, bese umisa noma ushintsha umsebenzi uma kudingeka.
app_store.release_notes: Clearer screens for playing together. The first picture game spreads each pair apart. Plan my day, Daily moment and other pages fit better with large text, and text follows your phone's size up to twice the normal size. Look together no longer counts the pictures. In Today, help numbers are labelled for the U.S., with a note to use a local number elsewhere. Translations are machine-made and not yet reviewed. If anything reads wrong, tell us from Help and privacy.
